Interface SensorModes

All Superinterfaces:
SampleProvider, SensorMode
public interface SensorModes extends SensorMode
A sensor with several modes. The sensor itself fetches samples in its current mode, and each mode is also available as its own SensorMode. Modes are numbered from 0 to getModeCount() - 1.

Enumerate the modes with getModeCount() and getMode(int). Implementations create their mode objects once, so getMode returns an existing instance rather than allocating one.
